name: megarachne_spider_1980
description: The 1980 (wrong) interpretation of Megarachne servinei: a huge hairy tarantula-like spider, top-down, head to the right: big round dark brown abdomen, broad cephalothorax with radial grooves and a small dark eye cluster, two prominent black fangs at the front, eight thick hairy banded legs (#4a3424 with lighter bands), hair strokes. Heavy and creepy, no face. Clean outline for the pale cyan X-ray version (ink #9fe6ff). Anchor centre. ~500x460 (x -250..250, y -235..235).
